title: Smaller-Titles
description: Smaller titles for the annoying Bed Wars messages and more.
body:
Tired of those huge "Bed Destroyed", "You Lost", or victory titles completely covering your screen while you're trying to PvP in Bedwars, Skywars, or other minigames?
This simple resource pack makes all big title and subtitle messages noticeably smaller while keeping them clearly visible. No more missing important info, and way less screen clutter during fights!
Features:

Smaller font for titles, subtitles, and actionbar messages
Still fully readable so you never miss a bed destruction or game event
Works great on Hypixel, other Bedwars servers, and singleplayer
Lightweight — only changes the default font size

Tested on Minecraft 1.21+
How to use:
Just download and enable the resource pack in your Minecraft options. It works alongside any other packs.
If the text is still too big or too small for your taste, feel free to leave a comment and I can make adjusted versions!
Enjoy cleaner gameplay!
Leave a review if it helped you — it really motivates me to keep improving these small QoL packs. ❤️
Made with love for the Minecraft community.
